chains.name: sash
chains.note: teal sash tails hanging at the front centre (head y -0.115 / z 0.995 → tail z 0.61, Blender); body radius 0.15 keeps the rest particles outside the Hips capsule (0.20 m at sash_2); max angle 50 (front tails between the thighs) — AP006C sash was 70 behind the hip. WP-111 R4 (S-06, 11.10): stiffness 0.45 → 0.85, damping 0.15 → 0.35 — at 0.45 / 0.15 the 6.2 m/s run pinned the tails on the 50° clamp 27 % of the frames (a hard stop between the thighs); the sweep (AnimationSecondaryTests.Oyuncu_Sash_SertlikSonum_Taramasi) gave 0.85 / 0.35: peak 46.9°, 0 % at the clamp, the tip still swings 27 cm
